field.label: Apprise URL
field.help: Where to send notifications, used when Service is set to Custom URL. An Apprise URL, e.g. tgram://bottoken/chatid, pover://userkey@apptoken or ntfys://topic. See the Apprise services for every supported service, its URL format and the options a URL can carry, or build one with the Apprise URL builder. The URL holds credentials, so it is never shown again; leave it empty to keep the saved URL.

field.label: Saved URL
field.help: The saved URL with its credentials masked.

field.label: Events
field.help: Events sent to this channel. Configuration changes, logins and intrusion detection alerts come from the firewall's own logs and audit trail; new devices come from Interfaces: Neighbors: Automatic Discovery. Monit alerts come from the services set up under Services: Monit, filtered by Monit services below; their state is read straight from the Monit daemon, so nothing needs changing there. System Status entries are the alerts behind the bell icon in the menu bar.

field.label: Monit services
field.help: Which Monit services this channel reports, when Monit alerts are among its events. Leave empty for all of them.
